claims.claim: Section 16c proposed by the bill would let the applicant, or a person other than the applicant, demand examination of a patent application within four years of the Israeli filing date. The explanatory notes state that if the applicant does not demand examination within four years the application is refused and no patent is registered.

claims.claim: לפי סעיף 134, באין הסכם הקובע אם העובד זכאי לתמורה בעד אמצאת שירות, הדבר ייקבע על ידי הוועדה לענייני פיצויים ותמלוגים.
claims.raw_snippet: תמורה בעד אמצאת שירות 134. באין הסכם הקובע אם זכאי העובד לתמורה בעד אמצאת שירות ,ובאיזו מידה ובאילו תנאים ,ייקבע הדבר על ידי הועדה לעניני פיצויים ותמלוגים

claims.claim: Section 132 of the Patents Law makes a service invention the employer's property in the absence of an agreement to the contrary, and Section 134 sends the question of remuneration to the compensation and royalties committee where there is no agreement.
claims.raw_snippet: Remuneration for service invention 134. If there is no agreement that prescribes whether, to what extent and on what conditions the employee is entitled to remuneration for a service invention, then the matter shall be decided by the compensation and royalties committee established under Chapter Six.

claims.claim: Section 18 of the Patents Law lists the additional means of examination, including a list of publications published prior to the application date which are known to the applicant and directly relate to the invention.
claims.raw_snippet: 18. (a) The examiner shall use at least one of the following additional means of examination:

claims.claim: Chapter Six of the Patents Law governs inventions of defence interest. Section 94 lets the Minister of Defense order the Registrar to refrain from acting on an application and restrict publication, and Section 98 bars an Israeli national or permanent resident from filing abroad an application for an invention that is weaponry, ammunition or otherwise of military value without prior written permission from the Minister of Defense.
claims.raw_snippet: Restriction of right to submit patent applications abroad (amendment no. 2) 1995 98. An Israel national, a permanent resident of Israel or any other person who owes allegiance to the State shall not submit any application abroad for a patent for an invention the subject of which is weaponry or ammunition, or which is otherwise of military value

claims.claim: Section 57 of the Patents Law allows a renewal fee that was not paid on time to be paid within six months thereafter with the addition of a prescribed fee, in which case the patent is deemed not to have lapsed.
claims.raw_snippet: Extension of time for payment of fees 57. If a renewal fee was not paid at the time prescribed for its payment, then it may be paid within six months thereafter with the addition of a fee in a prescribed amount

claims.claim: Section 52 of the Patents Law sets the term of a patent at twenty years from the application date.
claims.raw_snippet: Term of Patent 52. The term of a patent shall be twenty years from the application date.

claims.claim: The International Patent Classification, established by the Strasbourg Agreement (1971), is a hierarchical system of language independent symbols for classifying patents and utility models by area of technology, and a new version enters into force each year on January 1.
claims.raw_snippet: The International Patent Classification (IPC), established by the Strasbourg Agreement (1971), provides for a hierarchical system of language independent symbols for the classification of patents and utility models according to the different areas of technology to which they pertain.
